verdicts.reason: A has a strong left-to-right flow with a dominant headline and clear CTA, but the product bottle is shrunk to a tiny afterthought jammed into the top-right corner on a circle. The legal text is set as large as the subcopy, and the ribbon floats between the two columns without anchoring to either. B leaves the word 'last' orphaned in the headline and jams the ribbon tight against it, shrinks the logo to near-illegible size on top of a bubble, sets the headline weakly for its role, and isolates the CTA far to the right with dead space around it.
